cases.setup: Submit one frozen model candidate.
cases.expected: The created Memory is CANDIDATE and is absent from recall.

cases.setup: Confirm a Candidate with explicitConfirmation=true as its owner.
cases.expected: The Candidate becomes CONFIRMED and can be recalled.

cases.setup: Omit or set explicitConfirmation=false.
cases.expected: No Candidate changes state.

cases.setup: Renew the Session and Delegation for the same stable Human.
cases.expected: The same Human can confirm and recall the existing Candidate.

cases.setup: A second authorized Human in the same Tenant targets the owner's Memory.
cases.expected: Confirmation and content access fail; recall is empty.

cases.setup: Use another Tenant's candidate reference or route context.
cases.expected: Catalog or C05/C07 binding rejects before storage.

cases.setup: Recall a mix of Candidate, Confirmed, terminal and expired records.
cases.expected: Tenant, Principal, state and expiry filters run before item authorization and content read.

cases.setup: C06 denies one structurally eligible Memory.
cases.expected: Its content is never read or returned.

cases.setup: Return a C06 decision bound to another workload Actor or Delegation.
cases.expected: C09 rejects before the final C05 check, Tenant admission or storage.

cases.setup: Resolve Human A, authorize, then resolve Human B for the same request.
cases.expected: C09 detects the identity switch before Tenant admission or storage.

cases.setup: The owner pauses the Profile.
cases.expected: Recall returns an empty list and new candidates/checkpoints cannot be written.

cases.setup: The owner resumes a paused Profile with the current version.
cases.expected: Existing still-valid Confirmed Memories can be recalled.

cases.setup: Try ENTERPRISE_FACT, PRICE, ORDER, CONTRACT, CERTIFICATION or KPI.
cases.expected: Service catalog and PostgreSQL category constraint reject the value.

cases.setup: Add caller-supplied content/category fields to a model proposal.
cases.expected: Closed input validation rejects; only the frozen Tenant catalog supplies content.

cases.setup: Explicitly correct one Confirmed Memory with a frozen replacement.
cases.expected: Old content is scrubbed as DELETED and only the replacement is recalled.

cases.setup: Delete a Confirmed Memory referenced by a Checkpoint.
cases.expected: The Memory ID is atomically removed from every owner Checkpoint.

cases.setup: The owner explicitly deletes Candidate or Confirmed Memory.
cases.expected: State becomes DELETED, content becomes NULL and only a hash-only tombstone Event remains.

cases.setup: Move the trusted clock beyond expiresAt.
cases.expected: The record is excluded even before materializing its EXPIRED event.

cases.setup: Expire a due Candidate or Confirmed Memory.
cases.expected: State becomes EXPIRED and content is scrubbed.

cases.setup: Export/reload memory state and restart the PostgreSQL Store after deletion.
cases.expected: Deleted content and Checkpoint references do not reappear.

cases.setup: Repeat the exact command with the same owner and idempotency key.
cases.expected: The original result returns and no second Event is created.

cases.setup: Reuse the idempotency key with changed content or command.
cases.expected: The command fails with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

cases.setup: Two requests confirm version 1 concurrently.
cases.expected: One transition commits; the other observes stale or invalid state.

cases.setup: Use real PostgreSQL with a signed Tenant scope and a signed stable Principal scope.
cases.expected: RLS exposes only rows matching both signatures.

cases.setup: Suspend a stable Human and advance its lifecycle/security epoch after a Memory is confirmed.
cases.expected: A stale identity cannot obtain a Principal scope or read the prior content.

cases.setup: Inspect runtime and signer roles plus table grants.
cases.expected: Roles are non-superuser/NOBYPASSRLS; runtime cannot DELETE or mutate append-only Events.

cases.setup: Inspect all five Tenant/Principal-scoped tables.
cases.expected: Each table has ENABLE and FORCE RLS with the principal-scope predicate.

cases.setup: Try to UPDATE or DELETE a MemoryEvent.
cases.expected: Privileges and append-only triggers reject the mutation.

cases.setup: Execute one personal-memory command.
cases.expected: C05 identity, C06 authorization, C03 admission and C07/C09 scope occur before storage.
